subject: Renewal kickoff: term change proposal, capacity uplift & QBR slotting
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Grant <samuel@edgewave.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff: term change proposal, capacity uplift & QBR slotting

Hi Samuel —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Wanted to kick off the formal renewal thread so we can align on timeline, stakeholders, and a QBR window. High-level items we want to cover:

- Proposed term change: move to an 18-month committed term (vs current 12mo) to secure preferred pricing tiers.
- Capacity uplift: +30% baseline throughput for the ramp period, with seasonal burst headroom.
- Pricing tiers & discount thresholds (I attached a short summary).
- Evidence & procurement asks (SOC 2 evidence, retention window) for your procurement team.

Proposed QBR windows (please pick one):
- Tue, 17 May 2027, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu, 19 May 2027, 14:00–15:00 PT

Next steps for us if you confirm a slot: we’ll circulate a meeting agenda, send a short one‑page SOW outline and the renewal draft for your legal team, and loop in our SRE/CS lead for throughput sizing. Attachment: renewal_summary_EdgeWave.pdf (summary of options).

Who should I loop into procurement on your side?

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: renewal_summary_EdgeWave.pdf

From: Samuel Grant <samuel@edgewave.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: EdgeWave Procurement <procurement@edgewave.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: term change proposal, capacity uplift & QBR slotting

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the clear summary.

May 19, 14:00 PT works best for us for the QBR. Please hold that slot for now. I’m looping procurement so they have visibility. Procurement lead is Tara Liu (tara@edgewave.com) — she’ll own contract timing.

A couple of questions up front so we can prep:
- Can you confirm proposed ramp schedule (start date + expected attainment to new baseline)?
- What discount bands apply at 18 months vs 12 months?
- Any changes to retention / logging that would affect our compliance team?

We’d like to see a draft SOW and the renewal document ahead of the call.

Sam
Samuel Grant
Head of Platform, EdgeWave Inc.
samuel@edgewave.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Grant <samuel@edgewave.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Tara Liu <tara@edgewave.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: term change proposal, capacity uplift & QBR slotting

Sam / Tara —

Great, we’ll lock Thu, 19 May 2027 14:00 PT for the QBR (calendar invite will follow). Attached is a first-pass renewal draft (EdgeWave_Renewal_Draft_v1.docx) and a short SOW outline. Quick answers to Sam’s questions below:

- Ramp schedule: anticipated start of new term 1 Jun 2027; expect to reach 60% of new baseline within 6 weeks, 90% within 12 weeks assuming current request patterns. We’ll provide an operations runbook in the QBR.
- Discount bands: 12 months = standard pricing; 18 months = 12% discount at baseline spend tier, additional 3% for >25% uplift commit. Exact tiering included in the draft.
- Retention & compliance: no change to default retention; we can propose a custom retention window and a dataplane export for audit if needed (SOC 2 evidence is available — happy to share the pack).

Next steps (recommended):
1) Tara — confirm PO timing and any procurement-specific clauses you need us to prefill.
2) EdgeWave — share any updated monthly token/throughput numbers you expect for the upcoming fiscal year.
3) Redwood — we’ll circulate the QBR agenda + SRE attendee list 3 business days before the call.

Doc links: HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/987654/company/EdgeWave; DocuSign preview: https://docusign.com/sign/EW-4512-DRAFT

Thanks — attaching EdgeWave_Renewal_Draft_v1.docx

Lauren

Attachments: EdgeWave_Renewal_Draft_v1.docx

From: Tara Liu <tara@edgewave.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Samuel Grant <samuel@edgewave.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: term change proposal, capacity uplift & QBR slotting

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for looping us in. A few procurement items we need before legal will engage: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (within last 12 months) and any PenTest summaries you can provide.
- Standard SLA and retention language; we may request a 7-year audit retention clause depending on data class.
- Draft SOW and a PO template (we use a standard PO format). I attached our PO template for reference.

If you can provide the SOC 2 package and a preliminary SOW prior to the QBR that’ll speed review. Also please confirm the billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly) and whether the DocuSign draft is editable for our legal team.

Regards —
Tara Liu
Procurement Manager, EdgeWave Inc.
procurement@edgewave.com

Attachments: PO_template.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: QBR agenda and staffing plan (EdgeWave)

Internal notes — do not forward.

I listened to Lauren’s cadence here and drafted a short agenda and staffing ask for the QBR on 19 May:

Proposed QBR agenda (30–45 min):
- 5m Introductions & renewal objective (Lauren)
- 10m Usage & capacity review (CS/SRE) — show current vs requested uplift
- 10m Proposed commercial terms & rollout schedule (Lauren/Karthik)
- 10m Procurement Qs & compliance evidence (Monica)
- 5m Next steps & action owners (Lauren)

Staffing ask:
- Monica: lead compliance/SOC 2 and retention discussion (Monica to bring SOC 2 pack).
- SRE: one senior infra engineer (30m) to review expected KV cache and autoscaling assumptions.
- Solutions: one AE for technical sizing (Lauren).

Deliverables before QBR:
- Finalized SOW-staffing.xlsx (attached)
- SOC 2 package for Tara
- Slide deck with ramp assumptions and sample throughput graphs

Can you both confirm who on SRE we should loop in? I’ll own the commercial bullets in the call.

Karthik
VP, Customer Success (renewals)

Attachments: SOW-staffing.xlsx
